title: blog1,先看this
author: 一个傻逼
excerpt: This is the first post of my blog.
body:
Welcome to my *new blog*但是我在用AI开发出一个能够实时在网页上发或者改blog之前我应该不会动它了,其它几篇blog都是内置内容,跟我没关系

如果有大佬看到了能不能教我前段啊,ai一堆bug,我用qwen写还要用grok修我操

title: My Second Blog Post
author: Astro Learner
excerpt: After learning some Astro, I couldn't stop!
body: After a successful first week learning Astro, I decided to try some more. I wrote and imported a small component from memory!

title: My Third Blog Post
author: Astro Learner
excerpt: I had some challenges, but asking in the community really helped!
body: It wasn't always smooth sailing, but I'm enjoying building with Astro. And, the [Discord community](https://astro.build/chat) is really friendly and helpful!

title: My Fourth Blog Post
author: Astro Learner
excerpt: This post will show up on its own!
body: This post should show up with my other blog posts, because `import.meta.glob()` is returning a list of all my posts in order to create my list.
